## Summary

Describe the user-visible result and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Behavioral test added or updated
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run release:check`

## Release and provenance review

- [ ] No project media, recovery data, generated output, credentials, or personal information added
- [ ] New dependencies and network destinations are disclosed
- [ ] Copied or generated material includes creator, source, license, and modification records
- [ ] Privacy, security, packaging, and third-party notices are updated when applicable
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution and accept `CONTRIBUTING.md`
